_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a defined reference baseline of bugfest environment (currently 3 standalone tenants, and 11 consortia tenants). See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file.

deployment.description: Stateless HTTP and Kafka consumer module.

kong.description: Custom Kong proxy timeouts. Read timeout is raised above the 60s default because synchronous index-management operations on the search cluster (for example index creation and tenant data removal) can take longer than a regular search, whose query timeout is 25s.

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name used as the Kafka topic and consumer-group prefix; must be unique across environments sharing the same Kafka and OpenSearch clusters.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_AUTOMATIC_RETRIES_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables automatic retries of outbound requests on I/O errors.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_CONNECTION_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Maximum time to wait for a connection to be leased from the outbound pool; unset keeps the HTTP client default of 3 minutes.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_CONNECTION_TIME_TO_LIVE
EnvVars.description: Maximum total lifetime of a pooled connection for outbound module-to-module HTTP clients; unset means connections live as long as they are usable.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: TCP connect timeout for outbound module-to-module HTTP clients; it does not limit request duration.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_EVICT_IDLE_CONNECTIONS_AFTER
EnvVars.description: Idle time after which a background evictor closes pooled outbound connections; unset disables idle eviction.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_ROUTE
EnvVars.description: Maximum persistent connections per route for outbound module-to-module HTTP clients; keep it at or above the reindex merge range publisher max pool size.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_MAX_CONNECTIONS_TOTAL
EnvVars.description: Maximum total persistent connections across all routes for outbound module-to-module HTTP clients; keep it at or above the per-route maximum.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_POOL_CONCURRENCY_POLICY
EnvVars.description: Pool concurrency policy of outbound module-to-module HTTP clients: STRICT enforces connection limits exactly, LAX allows better concurrency but may exceed them.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_POOL_REUSE_POLICY
EnvVars.description: Connection reuse policy of outbound module-to-module HTTP clients: LIFO reuses the most recently released connection, FIFO the oldest.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Maximum time to wait for a response after an outbound request was sent; unset means no limit, which long-running reindex requests rely on.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_SOCKET_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Maximum inactivity between two data packets for outbound module-to-module HTTP clients; unset means no limit.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_EXCHANGE_HTTP_CLIENT_VALIDATE_AFTER_INACTIVITY
EnvVars.description: Inactivity period after which a pooled outbound connection is validated before reuse; unset keeps the HTTP client default.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_EXCHANGE_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables logging of outbound module-to-module HTTP client requests.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_EXCHANGE_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Detail level of outbound request logging, one of NONE, BASIC, HEADERS or FULL; applies only when outbound request logging is enabled.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_REQUEST_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables the incoming request logging filter.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_REQUEST_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Detail level of incoming request logging, one of NONE, BASIC, HEADERS or FULL; requests are only logged when DEBUG logging is enabled for the request logging filter.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of the gateway used for module-to-module requests.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_COMPRESSION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables request and response compression for search engine calls.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_CONNECTION_TIME_TO_LIVE
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime of a pooled search engine connection before it is evicted and recreated.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_IS_ELASTICSEARCH
EnvVars.description: Set to true when the search engine is Elasticsearch and to false when it is OpenSearch.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_MAX_CONN_PER_ROUTE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of persistent connections per route in the search engine HTTP connection pool.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_MAX_CONN_TOTAL
EnvVars.description: Maximum total number of persistent connections across all routes in the search engine HTTP connection pool.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_MAX_IDLE_TIME
EnvVars.description: Idle time after which a pooled search engine connection is closed; keep it below any firewall or load balancer idle timeout.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the search engine; not required when the cluster has no authentication.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_SEARCH_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of retries for a failed search request to the search engine.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_SEARCH_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS
EnvVars.description: Time in milliseconds to wait between search request retries.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_URL
EnvVars.description: URL of the OpenSearch or Elasticsearch cluster; the code falls back to localhost, which is only suitable for local development.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: Username for the search engine; not required when the cluster has no authentication.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_ENGINE_VALIDATE_AFTER_INACTIVITY
EnvVars.description: Inactivity period after which a pooled connection is validated before reuse; unset disables the check.

EnvVars.name: DB_CHARSET
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL connection character encoding applied to Hikari connections by folio-spring-base.

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Time in milliseconds after which an idle database connection is closed; 0 keeps idle connections open indefinitely.

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name used by the module datasource.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host used by the datasource JDBC URL.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of Hikari database connections opened by one module instance; unset keeps the Hikari default.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime in milliseconds of a database connection, idle or not, before it is closed; 0 means unlimited.

EnvVars.name: DB_MINSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Minimum number of idle Hikari database connections maintained in the pool by folio-spring-base.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the PostgreSQL user used by the module datasource.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port used by the datasource JDBC URL.

EnvVars.name: DB_QUERYTIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL statement timeout in milliseconds applied to Hikari connections by folio-spring-base; unset means no timeout.

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL username used by the module datasource.

EnvVars.name: BROWSE_CALL_NUMBERS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables the call-number browse feature globally.

EnvVars.name: BROWSE_CLASSIFICATIONS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables the classification browse feature globally.

EnvVars.name: BROWSE_CONTRIBUTORS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables the contributor browse feature globally.

EnvVars.name: BROWSE_SUBJECTS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables the subject browse feature globally.

EnvVars.name: DELETE_QUERY_BATCH_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of documents processed per batch by delete-by-query operations on the search cluster.

EnvVars.name: DELETE_QUERY_REFRESH
EnvVars.description: Refreshes affected indices after a delete-by-query operation completes.

EnvVars.name: DELETE_QUERY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
EnvVars.description: Request timeout in minutes for delete-by-query operations.

EnvVars.name: DELETE_QUERY_SCROLL_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
EnvVars.description: Scroll context keep-alive in minutes for delete-by-query operations.

EnvVars.name: FAILED_INDEXING_EVENTS_RETENTION_DAYS
EnvVars.description: Number of days failed indexing events are kept before the daily cleanup deletes them.

EnvVars.name: INDEXING_DATA_FORMAT
EnvVars.description: Serialisation format of documents sent to the search cluster, json or smile.

EnvVars.name: INITIAL_LANGUAGES
EnvVars.description: Comma-separated list of language codes configured for multi-language fields on tenant initialisation.

EnvVars.name: INSTANCE_CHILDREN_INDEX_DELAY_MS
EnvVars.description: Delay in milliseconds of the scheduler that indexes subjects, contributors, classifications and call numbers in the background.

EnvVars.name: INSTANCE_CHILDREN_INDEX_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables background processing of subjects, contributors, classifications and call numbers.

EnvVars.name: ITEM_INDEX_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables indexing of inventory item events into the standalone item index used by the item search endpoint.

EnvVars.name: MAX_BROWSE_REQUEST_OFFSET
EnvVars.description: Maximum search query offset allowed for additional requests when browsing around a value.

EnvVars.name: MAX_SEARCH_BATCH_REQUEST_IDS_COUNT
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of record IDs allowed in a batch request when searching consolidated holdings and items in a consortium.

EnvVars.name: MAX_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of languages a tenant can have configured.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_LOCATION_BATCH_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of locations retrieved per inventory HTTP request during location reindex.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_MERGE_EXPORT_BATCH_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of entities exported per batch during the merge phase of reindex in EXPORT mode.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_MERGE_RANGE_PUBLISHER_CORE_POOL_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of threads kept in the pool that publishes merge ranges, even when idle.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_MERGE_RANGE_PUBLISHER_MAX_POOL_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of threads in the pool that publishes merge ranges.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_MERGE_RANGE_PUBLISHER_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of retries for publishing a reindex merge range request.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_MERGE_RANGE_PUBLISHER_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS
EnvVars.description: Retry interval in milliseconds for publishing a reindex merge range request.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_MERGE_RANGE_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of entities in one merge range during the merge phase of reindex.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_MIGRATION_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL statement_timeout for migration operations on staging tables, in milliseconds when a plain number; 0 disables it.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_MIGRATION_WORK_MEM
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL work_mem applied to migration operations on staging tables before data spills to temporary disk files.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_S3_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of retries for remote storage file reads during EXPORT-mode reindex.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_S3_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS
EnvVars.description: Retry interval in milliseconds between remote storage file read attempts during EXPORT-mode reindex.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Reindex data ingestion strategy: PUBLISH for Kafka payload events or EXPORT for file-ready events from remote storage.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_UPLOAD_RANGE_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Depth of the upload range generator, which determines how many ranges are generated.

EnvVars.name: REINDEX_UPLOAD_RANGE_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of entities in one upload range during the upload phase of reindex.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_BY_ALL_FIELDS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables searching by all field values globally; tenants can override it.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_CONSORTIUM_RECORDS_PAGE_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of records requested from the search cluster per page for consortium searches.

EnvVars.name: SEARCH_QUERY_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Maximum time to wait for a search cluster response to a search query.

EnvVars.name: STALE_LOCK_THRESHOLD_MS
EnvVars.description: Age in milliseconds after which a sub-resource lock is considered stale and eligible for release.

EnvVars.name: STREAM_ID_CORE_POOL_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of threads kept in the stream-IDs pool, even when idle.

EnvVars.name: STREAM_ID_JOB_EXPIRATION_DAYS
EnvVars.description: Number of days after which a stream-IDs job is considered expired and cleaned up.

EnvVars.name: STREAM_ID_MAX_POOL_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of threads in the stream-IDs pool.

EnvVars.name: STREAM_ID_QUEUE_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Capacity of the stream-IDs task queue.

EnvVars.name: STREAM_ID_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of retries for a stream-IDs query after the first attempt failed.

EnvVars.name: STREAM_ID_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS
EnvVars.description: Time in milliseconds to wait before retrying a failed stream-IDs query.

EnvVars.name: STREAM_ID_SCROLL_QUERY_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of records loaded by each scroll query when streaming IDs; 10000 is the maximum.

EnvVars.name: SUB_RESOURCE_BATCH_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of sub-resources processed at a time during background indexing.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_AUTHORITIES_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for authority events.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_BROWSE_CONFIG_DATA_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for classification-type and call-number-type events.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_CONSORTIUM_INSTANCE_SHARING_COMPLETE_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for consortium instance sharing complete events.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_EVENTS_MAX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
EnvVars.description: Maximum processing time in milliseconds allowed between polls for the inventory events consumer.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_EVENTS_MAX_POLL_RECORDS
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of records returned in a single poll by the inventory events consumer.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_INSTANCE_MAX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
EnvVars.description: Maximum processing time in milliseconds allowed between polls for the index-instance consumer.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_INSTANCE_MAX_POLL_RECORDS
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of records returned in a single poll by the index-instance consumer.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_MAX_POLL_RECORDS
EnvVars.description: Default maximum number of records returned in a single Kafka consumer poll.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_EVENTS_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for inventory instance, holdings, item and bound-with events.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host used to build the bootstrap servers address.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_INDEX_INSTANCE_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for the index-instance topic.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_INDEX_INSTANCE_TOPIC_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions of the index-instance topic.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_LINKED_DATA_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for linked-data authority, work and hub events.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_LOCATION_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for location, campus, institution and library events.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port used to build the bootstrap servers address.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: Qualifier that replaces the tenant ID in the names of Kafka topics the module produces to, so events of all tenants share one topic per type; must match [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,30} or startup fails, and unset keeps per-tenant topics.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_REINDEX_FILE_READY_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for the inventory reindex file-ready topic.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_REINDEX_RANGE_INDEX_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for the reindex range-index topic.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_REINDEX_RANGE_INDEX_TOPIC_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions of the reindex range-index topic.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_REINDEX_RANGE_INDEX_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor of the reindex range-index and index-instance topics; unset uses the broker default.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_REINDEX_RECORDS_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for the inventory reindex-records topic.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_RETRY_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of delivery attempts for a Kafka message after the first one failed.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS
EnvVars.description: Time in milliseconds to wait before retrying a failed Kafka message delivery.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Security protocol used to communicate with Kafka brokers (PLAINTEXT or SSL).

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Path of the Kafka key store file, used for two-way TLS authentication when the security protocol is SSL.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the Kafka key store file; only needed when the key store location is set.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Path of the Kafka trust store file, used when the security protocol is SSL.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the Kafka trust store file; without it the trust store is still used but integrity checking is disabled.

EnvVars.name: S3_REINDEX_ACCESS_KEY_ID
EnvVars.description: Access key ID for object storage in EXPORT-mode reindex; required only when the reindex type is EXPORT.

EnvVars.name: S3_REINDEX_BUCKET
EnvVars.description: Object storage bucket used for reindex in EXPORT mode; required only when the reindex type is EXPORT.

EnvVars.name: S3_REINDEX_IDLE_KEEP_ALIVE_SECONDS
EnvVars.description: Keep-alive time in seconds for idle object storage connections; unset keeps the client default.

EnvVars.name: S3_REINDEX_IS_AWS
EnvVars.description: Selects AWS SDK behaviour (true) or generic S3-compatible behaviour (false) for reindex remote storage.

EnvVars.name: S3_REINDEX_MAX_IDLE_CONNECTIONS
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of idle object storage connections kept in the pool; unset keeps the client default.

EnvVars.name: S3_REINDEX_MAX_REQUESTS_PER_HOST
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of concurrent object storage requests per host; unset keeps the client default.

EnvVars.name: S3_REINDEX_REGION
EnvVars.description: Object storage region used for reindex in EXPORT mode; the code falls back to an AWS region when unset.

EnvVars.name: S3_REINDEX_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
EnvVars.description: Secret access key for object storage in EXPORT-mode reindex; required only when the reindex type is EXPORT.

EnvVars.name: S3_REINDEX_URL
EnvVars.description: Object storage endpoint used for reindex in EXPORT mode.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container (shares a task/pod with mod-search)

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size; the sidecar is proxy-bound rather than data-processing-bound, so a smaller heap than a typical module is appropriate

java.name: xms
java.description: Initial Java heap size; set to half of xmx to reduce startup GC pressure

java.name: UseZGC
java.description: Use ZGC low-pause collector; preferred for a proxy-shaped workload where tail latency matters more than throughput

EnvVars.name: MOD_USERS_KEYCLOAK_CACHE_EXPIRATION_SECONDS
EnvVars.description: TTL in seconds for user-keycloak mapping cache entries.

EnvVars.name: MOD_USERS_KEYCLOAK_CACHE_INITIAL_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Initial capacity of the user-keycloak mapping cache used by the impersonation filter.

EnvVars.name: MOD_USERS_KEYCLOAK_CACHE_MAX_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of cached user-keycloak mappings used by the impersonation filter.

EnvVars.name: TENANT_MODULE_BINDING_CACHE_EXPIRATION_MINUTES
EnvVars.description: TTL in minutes for tenant-module binding cache entries. Entries are also evicted eagerly via entitlement Kafka events; this expiry is the safety net for missed events.

EnvVars.name: TENANT_MODULE_BINDING_CACHE_MAX_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of tenant-to-module-version bindings held in the Caffeine cache. Raise proportionally to the number of entitled tenants.

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_INITIAL_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Initial capacity of the token cache.

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_MAX_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of cached service/system-user tokens in the Caffeine token cache. Raise for deployments with many active tenants.

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_REFRESH_PRIOR_EXPIRATION
EnvVars.description: Seconds before a cached token's expiry at which the sidecar proactively refreshes it to avoid serving an expired token under load.

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_RETRIEVAL_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Timeout in seconds for a token-cache population request to Keycloak before the cache entry is considered failed.

EnvVars.name: AM_CLIENT_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of mgr-applications. The sidecar fetches its module bootstrap (routing entries, required modules) from this service on startup.

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical FOLIO deployment name (e.g. folio). Used as the Kafka topic prefix for the discovery and entitlement consumers.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_HEALTH_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path appended to MODULE_URL for the module health-check probe used by the sidecar startup readiness check.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Logical FOLIO module name (e.g. mod-users). Used to fetch the module descriptor from mgr-applications and build the composite MODULE_ID.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of the co-located module container. In a task/pod deployment this is the sibling container's address and port (e.g. http://mod-users:8082).

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Semantic version of the accompanied module (e.g. 19.5.4). Combined with MODULE_NAME to form MODULE_ID used for descriptor lookup and Kafka routing.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT
EnvVars.description: ECS container metadata endpoint used as the credentials provider when SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM is false.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path appended to SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT to form the full credentials URL.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_FIPS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables FIPS-compliant endpoints for the AWS SSM client.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region for the SSM parameter store backend. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Trust store file type for the AWS SSM client (e.g. JKS, BCFKS).

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the AWS SSM trust store.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the trust store used by the AWS SSM TLS client. Required when SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_FIPS_ENABLED is true.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: Use the attached IAM role for AWS SSM authentication instead of explicit access keys. Set to false only when running outside EC2/ECS without an instance profile.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Base URL of the Folio Secure Store Proxy (FSSP). Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=FSSP.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_KEYSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Key store file type for the FSSP client (e.g. JKS, BCFKS).

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the FSSP key store.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_KEYSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the FSSP mutual TLS key store.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_SECRET_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path within FSSP used to look up module credentials.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Trust store file type for the FSSP client (e.g. JKS, BCFKS).

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the FSSP trust store.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the FSSP trust store.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Secret store backend used to retrieve Keycloak client credentials. One of: EPHEMERAL (in-memory, dev only), AWS_SSM, VAULT, FSSP. Must be set explicitly in all non-development deployments.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Address of the HashiCorp Vault instance. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Enables SSL for the Vault connection when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the Vault SSL key store for mutual TLS authentication.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Vault SSL key store.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_PEM_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the PEM certificate file for Vault SSL verification.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TOKEN
EnvVars.description: Root or service token for Vault authentication. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the Vault SSL trust store.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_NAME
EnvVars.description: Logical sidecar name; defaults to sc-{MODULE_NAME} and is used as the Kafka consumer group prefix. Override only when multiple sidecar instances for the same module must use distinct consumer groups.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_URL
EnvVars.description: Externally reachable URL of this sidecar instance. Used by other sidecars for module-to-module egress routing; must be resolvable from within the cluster.

EnvVars.name: TE_CLIENT_BATCH_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Page size for paginated tenant-entitlement queries against mgr-tenant-entitlements.

EnvVars.name: TE_CLIENT_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of mgr-tenant-entitlements. Used to load the initial tenant-to-module entitlement list on startup.

EnvVars.name: TM_BATCH_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Page size for paginated tenant queries against mgr-tenants.

EnvVars.name: TM_CLIENT_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of mgr-tenants. Used to resolve tenant metadata during ingress authorization.

EnvVars.name: ALLOW_CROSS_TENANT_REQUESTS
EnvVars.description: Allows ingress requests that carry a tenant header different from the token's tenant claim. Enable in consortia deployments where cross-tenant API access is intentional.

EnvVars.name: RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Maximum retry attempts for startup-time calls to mgr-applications and mgr-tenant-entitlements.

EnvVars.name: RETRY_BACKOFF_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Exponential backoff multiplier applied to the retry delay between startup-time attempts.

EnvVars.name: RETRY_MAX_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Maximum backoff delay between startup-time retries.

EnvVars.name: RETRY_MIN_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Minimum backoff delay between startup-time retries.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_REQUESTS
EnvVars.description: Forwards requests that do not match any known route to the gateway specified by SIDECAR_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_REQUESTS_DESTINATION instead of returning 404.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_REQUESTS_DESTINATION
EnvVars.description: Gateway URL to which unrecognized requests are forwarded when SIDECAR_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_REQUESTS is true.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_MODULE_PATH_PREFIX_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables a module-name path prefix on ingress routes (e.g. /mod-users/...). Required when Kong routes all modules through a single sidecar port distinguished by path prefix.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_MODULE_PATH_PREFIX_STRATEGY
EnvVars.description: Path-prefix handling strategy when SIDECAR_MODULE_PATH_PREFIX_ENABLED is true. NONE leaves the path unchanged; STRIP removes the module prefix before forwarding to MODULE_URL.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_TENANT_SCOPED_ROUTING_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Restricts ingress routing to routes explicitly entitled for the request tenant. When true, unrecognized routes return 404 instead of being forwarded.

EnvVars.name: DISCOVERY_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Kafka security protocol for the discovery topic consumer. Set to SSL or SASL_SSL in TLS-secured clusters.

EnvVars.name: DISCOVERY_TLS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the discovery consumer key store.

EnvVars.name: DISCOVERY_TLS_KEYSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the key store for the discovery consumer SSL client authentication.

EnvVars.name: DISCOVERY_TLS_KEY_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the private key inside the discovery consumer key store when SSL client authentication is configured.

EnvVars.name: DISCOVERY_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_CERTIFICATES
EnvVars.description: PEM-encoded CA certificates inlined as an alternative to DISCOVERY_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH for the discovery consumer.

EnvVars.name: DISCOVERY_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the discovery consumer trust store.

EnvVars.name: DISCOVERY_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the trust store for the discovery Kafka consumer SSL connection. Required when DISCOVERY_SECURITY_PROTOCOL is SSL.

EnvVars.name: DISCOVERY_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Trust store file type for the discovery consumer (e.g. JKS, BCFKS).

EnvVars.name: ENTITLEMENT_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Kafka security protocol for the entitlement topic consumer. Set to SSL or SASL_SSL in TLS-secured clusters.

EnvVars.name: ENTITLEMENT_TLS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the entitlement consumer key store.

EnvVars.name: ENTITLEMENT_TLS_KEYSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the key store for the entitlement consumer SSL client authentication.

EnvVars.name: ENTITLEMENT_TLS_KEY_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the private key inside the entitlement consumer key store when SSL client authentication is configured.

EnvVars.name: ENTITLEMENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_CERTIFICATES
EnvVars.description: PEM-encoded CA certificates inlined as an alternative to ENTITLEMENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH for the entitlement consumer.

EnvVars.name: ENTITLEMENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the entitlement consumer trust store.

EnvVars.name: ENTITLEMENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the trust store for the entitlement Kafka consumer SSL connection. Required when ENTITLEMENT_SECURITY_PROTOCOL is SSL.

EnvVars.name: ENTITLEMENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Trust store file type for the entitlement consumer (e.g. JKS, BCFKS).

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker hostname used to build the bootstrap-servers address for the discovery, entitlement, and logout consumers.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port used to build the bootstrap-servers address.

EnvVars.name: LOGOUT_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Kafka security protocol for the logout topic consumer. Set to SSL or SASL_SSL in TLS-secured clusters.

EnvVars.name: LOGOUT_TLS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the logout consumer key store.

EnvVars.name: LOGOUT_TLS_KEYSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the key store for the logout consumer SSL client authentication.

EnvVars.name: LOGOUT_TLS_KEY_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the private key inside the logout consumer key store when SSL client authentication is configured.

EnvVars.name: LOGOUT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_CERTIFICATES
EnvVars.description: PEM-encoded CA certificates inlined as an alternative to LOGOUT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH for the logout consumer.

EnvVars.name: LOGOUT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the logout consumer trust store.

EnvVars.name: LOGOUT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the trust store for the logout Kafka consumer SSL connection. Required when LOGOUT_SECURITY_PROTOCOL is SSL.

EnvVars.name: LOGOUT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Trust store file type for the logout consumer (e.g. JKS, BCFKS).

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak client ID used to obtain a realm admin token for RPT authorization requests.

EnvVars.name: KC_AUTHORIZATION_CACHE_MAX_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of RPT authorization results held in the Caffeine cache. Raise for deployments with many active users or high-cardinality permission sets.

EnvVars.name: KC_AUTHORIZATION_CACHE_TTL_OFFSET
EnvVars.description: Offset in milliseconds subtracted from the RPT token expiry to pre-emptively evict authorization cache entries before they expire.

EnvVars.name: KC_FORCED_JWKS_REFRESH_INTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Minimum interval in seconds between forced JWKS refreshes triggered by a failed JWT validation.

EnvVars.name: KC_INTROSPECTION_CACHE_TTL_OFFSET
EnvVars.description: Offset in milliseconds subtracted from the introspected token expiry to pre-emptively evict introspection cache entries.

EnvVars.name: KC_INTROSPECTION_INACTIVE_TOKEN_TTL_IN_SEC
EnvVars.description: TTL in seconds for negative (inactive) token introspection results to avoid hammering Keycloak on repeated invalid tokens.

EnvVars.name: KC_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN_CACHE_MAX_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of introspection results held in the Caffeine cache.

EnvVars.name: KC_JWKS_BASE_URL
EnvVars.description: Override base URL for JWKS retrieval. When empty the sidecar derives the JWKS URL from KC_URL. Set explicitly only when the Keycloak JWKS endpoint is hosted at a different address than the main KC_URL.

EnvVars.name: KC_JWKS_REFRESH_INTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Interval in seconds between scheduled JWKS cache refreshes.

EnvVars.name: KC_LOGIN_CLIENT_SUFFIX
EnvVars.description: Suffix appended to the tenant name to derive the Keycloak login client ID (e.g. diku-login-application).

EnvVars.name: KC_SERVICE_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak client ID used by the sidecar to obtain a service-account token for module-to-module egress calls.

EnvVars.name: KC_URI_VALIDATION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables Keycloak-side URI validation during token introspection. Set to false only in environments where Keycloak is not configured with per-resource URI policies.

EnvVars.name: KC_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of the Keycloak instance. Used for JWKS retrieval, JWT validation, and token introspection.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_IMPERSONATION_CLIENT_NAME
EnvVars.description: Keycloak client ID used for impersonation token exchange in the impersonation filter.

EnvVars.name: GW_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables TLS on the gateway web client used when SIDECAR_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_REQUESTS is true (fips profile only).

EnvVars.name: GW_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Trust store file type for the gateway TLS client (e.g. JKS, BCFKS).

EnvVars.name: GW_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the gateway TLS trust store.

EnvVars.name: GW_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the trust store for the gateway TLS client. Required when GW_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true.

EnvVars.name: GW_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PROVIDER
EnvVars.description: Security provider for the gateway TLS trust store (e.g. BCFIPS).

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables TLS on the Keycloak web client (fips profile only).

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Trust store file type for the Keycloak TLS client (e.g. JKS, BCFKS).

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Keycloak TLS trust store.

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the trust store for the Keycloak TLS client. Required when KC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true.

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PROVIDER
EnvVars.description: Security provider for the Keycloak TLS trust store (e.g. BCFIPS).

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_THREAD_POOL_MAX_THREADS
EnvVars.description: Maximum Quarkus worker thread pool size for blocking operations (e.g. secret store retrieval, JWKS parsing). Most proxy work is non-blocking; this pool is used sparingly.

EnvVars.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: HTTP client read timeout in milliseconds applied to all proxied requests. Raise for accompanied modules with legitimately long-running endpoints.

EnvVars.name: ROOT_LOG_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Root log level for the Quarkus logging framework.

EnvVars.name: SC_ACCESS_LOG_FORMAT
EnvVars.description: Access log format pattern for the transaction logger. When unset, the sidecar uses the built-in default pattern that includes remote IP, tenant, user ID, request ID, method, path, status, and timing fields.

EnvVars.name: SC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables mutual TLS on the egress web client. Active only under the fips Quarkus profile.

EnvVars.name: SC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Trust store file type for the egress TLS client (e.g. JKS, BCFKS).

EnvVars.name: SC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the egress TLS trust store.

EnvVars.name: SC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the trust store for the egress TLS client (fips profile only). Required when SC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true.

EnvVars.name: SC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PROVIDER
EnvVars.description: Security provider for the egress TLS trust store (e.g. BCFIPS in FIPS-compliant deployments).

EnvVars.name: SC_LOG_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Log level for the org.folio.sidecar package. Set to DEBUG or TRACE to diagnose routing and filter decisions.

EnvVars.name: SC_TLS_KEYSTORE_KEY_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the private key entry inside the sidecar HTTPS key store, when different from SC_TLS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD.

EnvVars.name: SC_TLS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the sidecar HTTPS key store.

EnvVars.name: SC_TLS_KEYSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the key store used to serve the sidecar's own HTTPS port (8443). Required in fips profile when TLS terminates at the sidecar.

EnvVars.name: SC_TLS_KEY_STORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Key store file type for the sidecar HTTPS server (e.g. JKS, BCFKS).

EnvVars.name: SC_TLS_KEY_STORE_PROVIDER
EnvVars.description: Security provider for the sidecar HTTPS key store (e.g. BCFIPS).

EnvVars.name: TENANT_SERVICE_RESET_TASK_CRON_DEFINITION
EnvVars.description: Quartz cron expression for the periodic tenant-entitlement reload flag reset.

EnvVars.name: WEB_CLIENT_TLS_VERIFY_HOSTNAME
EnvVars.description: Enables hostname verification on the egress, Keycloak, and gateway TLS web clients (fips profile only). Disable with caution — only in environments using self-signed certificates.
